text:
Elena: Quick thread to finalize the "Handshake" DP cadence + prioritization lanes. Goal: get 4 tight partners in 8 weeks and a clear path from feedback -> product lane.
Mark: Need a simple incentive ladder and a fast triage path. Finance wants per-partner monthly estimates.
Elena: Draft tiers: Lab (early access, no credits), Partner ($2k credits + 4 office hours), Anchor ($12k credits + 20h SRE + roadmap slot). Anchor requires 6-week stability commit.
Sora: For on-prem Anchors add one-time install stipend ($5k) and signed runbook. Also require a short anonymized case study for Anchor.
Priya: Intake fields should include data_sensitivity, KMS_required (y/n), logs_allowed (y/n), and desired SLA. If sensitive, mark for security pre-review.
dp-bot: New intake form published: https://console.redwood/dp/handshake (auto-tag: dp/handshake) :white_check_mark:
Elena: Feedback tagging: canonical tag `dp/handshake` + required fields: reproducible (y/n), severity (1-5), business_impact (low/med/high), suggested_fix. One-click export creates a triage card and optional GH issue.
Mark: Prioritization lanes idea: P0 (urgent fix), P1 (short-term roadmap), P2 (watchlist). Map rule: score = reproducible?3:0 + severity>=4?2:severity==3?1:0 + business_impact=="high"?2:business_impact=="med"?1:0. Then multiply by tier weight: Anchor x1.3, Partner x1.1, Lab x1.0. final >=7 -> P0, 5-6 -> P1, else P2.
Sora: Sampling and evals: week0 smoke, week1-4 rolling evals (NPS + regen rate + false positive). We persist evals with partner_id for later analysis.
Priya: Onboarding checklist (Partner): day0 access + API keys, day2 sample dataset + eval prompts, day7 baseline metrics + e2e smoke. Anchor gets extended optimization weeks 3-6. I'll draft templates.
Elena: Launch gate proposal: staging infra SLOs hold for 72h, partner E2E tests green, and no quality regression >1% vs partner baseline. If gate fails, schedule 3 day hotfix window.
Mark: Cost model (rough): Lab $50/mo, Partner $700/mo, Anchor $3,800/mo (amortized credits + SRE time). Need finance to confirm.
Sora: Security note: any PHI/PCI auto-triages to Sec and becomes urgent regardless of score. Add NDA addendum checkbox for high-sensitivity partners.
Elena: Rollout suggestion: month1: 1 internal Anchor + 2 Partners; month2: onboard 2 external Partners + 2 Labs staggered. Keep 1 SRE reserved per Anchor onboarding.
Priya: Action items: @Mark confirm finance numbers; @Sora add runbook + security checklist; @Priya post onboarding templates; @Elena publish intake & partner FAQ. Reconvene next Wed to lock terms.
Mark: Works for me. :thumbsup:
Sora: I'll add KMS checkbox and retention caps tonight.
Priya: Templates by EOD tomorrow.
Elena: Thanks team 331 small cohorts, fast signals. :seedling:
